# meshoptimizer decoder

`meshopt_decoder.js` is `meshopt_decoder.mjs` from meshoptimizer **1.3.0** (MIT, see LICENSE.md),
unmodified apart from the file extension. GLTFLoader uses it to decode the baked characters
(`EXT_meshopt_compression`, written by `tools/bake-characters.mjs` through gltfpack).

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/meshoptimizer/-/meshoptimizer-1.3.0.tgz
